title: Complete FRP lifecycle coverage
description: Verify and, where needed, fix FRP TOML/config generation, supported transport options, lifecycle, status/reconnect behavior, and config reload boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: FRP input validation rejects unsupported protocols/options and malformed port/host values
Generated TOML is deterministic, parseable, and keeps credentials out of diagnostics
Start/stop/restart/reconnect and config replacement have focused tests
A remote status failure is surfaced as degraded/unknown rather than falsely running

steps.details: Extend the custom harness with FRP valid/invalid schema, TOML parse, secret redaction, and lifecycle/status failure cases.
Read `config/frp.ts`, engine planner/process handling, and method-specific current tests; record concrete gaps only.
Correct config generation or state handling proven by the failing tests, preserving API/schema compatibility.
Run focused tests, custom harness, typecheck, and lint; record real frp binary/VPS evidence separately.

technicalNotes: FRP upstream protocol changes require pinned version documentation; do not claim compatibility without the tested version.
